directions.name: AgentGate
directions.description: 面向独立开发者的AI Agent身份验证中间件，一键接入OAuth2/PKI身份层
directions.description_en: An identity verification middleware for indie developers to easily add OAuth2/PKI identity layer to their AI Agent applications
directions.target_user: 构建AI Agent应用的独立开发者和小型团队
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and small teams building AI Agent applications
core_features: 标准化身份验证API接入，支持JWT/OIDC
Agent身份注册与凭证管理仪表板
与MCP协议兼容的身份中间件
core_features_en: Standardized identity verification API integration supporting JWT/OIDC
Agent identity registration and credential management dashboard
directions.why_now: 根据DEV Community社区讨论，AI Agent身份问题是当前最热的安全议题之一（入选评分7/10）。Reddit上多条帖子反映开发者面临Agent身份伪造和跨平台认证碎片化的痛点。文章系列'Trusted AI Agent Transactions'引发广泛讨论，表明市场亟需标准化的身份解决方案。
directions.why_now_en: Based on DEV Community discussions, AI Agent identity issues are one of the hottest security topics right now (rating 7/10). Multiple Reddit threads reflect developer pain points around Agent identity spoofing and cross-platform authentication fragmentation. The 'Trusted AI Agent Transactions' article series has sparked widespread discussion, indicating urgent market demand for standardized identity solutions.
directions.monetization: Freemium模式：免费层50个Agent/月，Pro版$29/月起按Agent数量计费
directions.monetization_en: Freemium model: free tier of 50 Agents/month, Pro at $29+/month based on Agent count
directions.source_article: Trusted AI Agent Transactions, Part 4: PingAuthorize Policy Decisions

directions.name: PolicyForge
directions.description: 可视化AI Agent权限策略编辑器，拖拽生成PingAuthorize兼容的授权规则
directions.description_en: Visual AI Agent permission policy editor that generates PingAuthorize-compatible authorization rules via drag-and-drop
directions.target_user: 需要精细化权限管理的AI应用开发者和安全工程师
directions.target_user_en: AI application developers and security engineers needing fine-grained permission management
core_features: 可视化策略编辑器，所见即所得生成授权规则
一键导出为JSON/YAML策略文件，兼容主流授权系统
策略测试沙盒，模拟Agent行为验证权限边界
core_features_en: Visual policy editor with WYSIWYG rule generation
One-click export to JSON/YAML policy files compatible with major authorization systems
Policy testing sandbox to simulate Agent behavior and verify permission boundaries
directions.why_now: DEV Community文章'Trusted AI Agent Transactions, Part 4'详细阐述了PingAuthorize策略决策机制，HN社区中关于AI Agent权限过度开放的安全讨论持续升温。开源社区对标准化授权架构的需求强烈（标签包含'开源项目'），而独立开发者缺乏现成的策略设计工具。
directions.why_now_en: The DEV Community article 'Trusted AI Agent Transactions, Part 4' details PingAuthorize policy decision mechanisms, while HN community discussions on AI Agent over-permissioning security continue to heat up. There is strong demand in the open source community for standardized authorization architecture (tagged 'open source project'), yet indie developers lack ready-to-use policy design tools.
directions.monetization: SaaS订阅$19/月起，企业版提供私有化部署选项$199/月起
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription at $19+/month, enterprise version offering on-premise deployment at $199+/month
directions.source_article: Trusted AI Agent Transactions, Part 1: The Identity Problem
